description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**不一样。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

>  If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the **request ID** as the **client token**. The **request ID** may be different for each request.

description.zh: 待修改的基础型全球加速实例终端节点所属的终端节点组ID。
description.en: The ID of the endpoint group to which the endpoint that you want to modify belongs.

description.zh: 待修改的基础型全球加速实例终端节点ID。
description.en: The ID of the endpoint that you want to modify.

description.zh:
基础型全球加速实例终端节点的名称。

名称长度为1~128个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）下划线（_）和短划线（-）。
description.en:
The name of the endpoint that is associated with the basic GA instance.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter.

description.zh: 全球加速所在的地域ID，仅取值**cn-hangzhou**。
description.en: The ID of the region where the GA instance is deployed. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**.

title.zh: 修改基础型全球加速实例的终端节点名称

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ga update-basic-endpoint --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --endpoint-group-id epg-bp1dmlohjjz4kqaun0000 --endpoint-id ep-bp14sz7ftcwwjgrdm0000 --name ep01 --region cn-hangzhou
